minor.issue: If an activation loses the race, enforce_after_activation only sets isAvailable back to false. The other edits in the same PUT (name, price...) are already saved, but the client gets a 403 and thinks nothing was saved.

The post-write recheck design can over-reject: if every concurrent writer writes before any of them checks, all of them roll back and nobody gets the 20th slot. It never happened in 3 runs (always 1 winner) and the limit is never exceeded.
